notes: New Phone / tablet button: switch it on and phones and tablets on the same Wi-Fi or LAN can open R6 Scout from your computer (scan the QR code, enter the PIN, Add to Home Screen). They can look at everything and save playlists; uploading and deleting stay on the computer. Off until you switch it on. Windows may ask to allow R6 Scout on the network: choose Private. Restart the app after updating.
